About This Auction

*Hybrid Auction* Property: 159+/- acres in Cowley County just north of Cambridge Auction Date: May 7th, 2025 at 6:00pm Central Auction Location: 401 N Main St, Burden, KS 67019 (Burden City Hall) This 159.4 acres sits just north of Cambridge, Kansas and east of Atlanta, KS. Laying in the southern region of the states prestigous Flint Hills, this property has a lot to offer. This area is very secluded and brings to factor some of the properties rare attributes of having rural water supplied buy Cowley County District #5 and electricity coming down the west side of the property serviced by Caney Valley Electric.  This location of Cowley County is well known for being cattle country and has some of the best native grasses found anywhere. Along with that it has no shortage of whitetail deer, having a couple of nice bucks taken on this property the past few years. There is a seasonal creek running through this property, angling across the property from northwest down to the southeast corner. This gives run off water into 2 of the ponds that are on the property. You'll notice on the topographical map that there is a lot of elevation change. Making a valley appearance and giving it a very seclusive feel once your out on the property. This provides excellent cover from the Kansas weather for livestock and wildlife.  Other aspects of this property is it has several areas of thicker brush making great bedding areas for deer. There is and old barn and homesite in the northwest corner. Several groves of mature hardwoods that create shade and 5 star treestand locations. On the north end of the property is a 8.5 acre field that has been established back into a bermuda grass mix but was once tilled and could be put back into some kind grain crop or hay meadow.   Nearby Towns: Atlanta, KS - 6 miles Burden, KS - 15 miles Winfield, KS - 32 miles Wichita, KS - 55 miles El Dorado, KS - 41 miles Nearby Amenities: Wichita Airport - 60 miles Walmart - 33 miles Latham Saloon - 10 miles
